title: WebAssembly packages
intro: Each npm package's module after `wasm-opt -Oz`, raw and gzipped at level 9. `cargo xtask package-wasm` fails a build whose gzipped module is over its budget.
table:
| Package | Holds | Module | gzip -9 | Budget | Headroom |
|---|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| `teigeodata-wasm` | every component | 618248 B | 260232 B | 262144 B | 0.7% |
| `teigeodata-wasm-lookup` | every query at a point or by ID | 393404 B | 152297 B | 153600 B | 0.8% |
| `teigeodata-wasm/store` | every component and the store | 1000388 B | 423840 B | 450560 B | 5.9% |
